business_problem: StudyFetch needed to process hundreds of thousands of lectures every month without the cost, latency, and accuracy limits of managed cloud transcription, because those bottlenecks constrained real-time tutoring and affordable personalized learning for millions of students.
solution_summary: StudyFetch rebuilt the ingestion and inference layers behind its AI learning workspace so live classroom content could be processed cheaply enough to serve more than 7 million learners. Live lectures, notes, and course materials are captured into a transcription pipeline that runs NVIDIA Riva with the Parakeet ASR model inside NVIDIA NIM containers on NVIDIA L40S GPUs, replacing a managed cloud transcription service. The resulting transcripts flow into StudyFetch's Learn Engine, where NVIDIA H100 and L40S GPUs handle more than 100 million learning interactions for tutoring, study plans, flashcards, and practice tests. The company is also adopting NVIDIA Nemotron models with distillation across the stack so conversational tutoring and course generation can move from closed APIs to dedicated accelerated infrastructure with more predictable cost, latency, and capacity.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Riva
solution_components.role: Runs the speech AI service that converts live lecture audio into real-time transcripts for downstream tutoring workflows.

solution_components.name: Parakeet ASR
solution_components.role: Provides the automatic speech recognition model used inside the transcription pipeline for classroom audio.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NIM
solution_components.role: Packages the transcription and model-serving microservices so a small team can operate them without a separate MLOps function.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA L40S GPUs
solution_components.role: Execute the real-time transcription workload and other inference tasks that support high-volume learning interactions.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA H100 GPUs
solution_components.role: Run the Learn Engine and support distillation and inference for larger tutoring and course-generation workloads.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Nemotron
solution_components.role: Supplies the open models that StudyFetch is distilling across its stack for tutoring and course-generation use cases.

data_flow: Live lectures, notes, and course content enter a Riva-plus-Parakeet transcription pipeline running in NIM containers on L40S GPUs. The transcripts feed StudyFetch's Learn Engine on H100 and L40S infrastructure, which routes learner requests into tutoring, flashcard, test, and course-generation experiences backed by distilled Nemotron models.
integration_points: Study plans, flashcards, and practice tests
business_outcome: StudyFetch cut the cost of its largest inference workload by roughly 10x, made lecture transcription real time, expanded AI learning workflows to more than 7 million learners, and created a path to shift tutoring and course generation from closed APIs onto dedicated open-model infrastructure.
metrics: Hundreds of thousands of lectures transcribed in real time every month
Roughly 10x reduction in cost on the largest inference workload
architecture_clues: The Learn Engine serves as an educational context layer
NIM packaging let a small team run the stack without a separate MLOps function
The platform is planning three 8-way NVIDIA B300 systems for additional open-model capacity
Lecture transcription is a foundational ingest layer for tutoring and study content
evidence_quotes: As demand grew into hundreds of thousands of lectures every month, the cost and accuracy ceilings of off-the-shelf cloud transcription threatened the company's core promise.

Migrating live lecture transcription onto NVIDIA Riva and Parakeet running on NVIDIA L40S GPUs in NVIDIA NIM containers delivered roughly a 10x reduction in cost on the company's largest inference workload.
StudyFetch's Learn Engine runs on NVIDIA H100 and L40S GPUs, routing each learner's requests across more than 100 million learning interactions.
StudyFetch is building AI-powered learning infrastructure for more than 7 million students, educators, and lifelong learners.
